question: With the same start route, does fresh-subagent rescue lower the cost per accepted task against the v5 legacy recovery, with no task lost? Ship the recovery at no task lost net and a cost ratio of 0.85 or less, interval upper bound under 1.0.
oracle: the task's accept command with its hidden tests: the full suite, never a subset the agent chose
cost: list-price-equivalent USD of every paid attempt of an arm, accepted or not, interrupted included, divided by its accepted tasks
pairs: a task counts when both arms have a valid row. A row is valid when the run finished (done, timeout or agent_error) and the grader gave a verdict.
inconclusive_next: independent repetitions of the discordant tasks only (one arm passes, the other fails) and of the tasks whose cost differs by more than 2x, for both arms
